definitions.explanation: Acting freely without being bound by rules, conventions, or others' expectations. Can describe a personality, lifestyle, or creative style. Generally positive or neutral, though it can imply recklessness depending on context.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{自由奔放|じゆうほんぽう}な⟦{性格|せいかく}→性格：03371_seikaku⟧だ。
{自由奔放|じゆうほんぽう}な⟦{生|い}き{方|かた}→生き方：10014_ikikata⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{憧|あこが}れる→憧れる：05302_akogareru⟧。
examples.english: I admire a free and uninhibited way of life.

examples.japanese: ⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦{画家|がか}→画家：02583_gaka⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{自由奔放|じゆうほんぽう}な⟦{作風|さくふう}→作風：11460_sakufuu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{知|し}られ→知る：00458_shiru⟧、⟦{型|かた}→型：02146_kata⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧はまらない⟦{作品|さくひん}→作品：02776_sakuhin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{多|おお}く→多い：01127_ooi⟧⟦{残|のこ}した→残す：01975_nokosu⟧。
examples.english: That painter was known for a freewheeling style and left behind many unconventional works.

notes:
A four-character compound (⟦{四字熟語|よじじゅくご}→四字熟語：15663_yojijukugo⟧) composed of ⟦{自由|じゆう}→自由：01148_jiyuu⟧ (freedom) and ⟦{奔放|ほんぽう}→奔放：20059_honpou⟧ (unrestrained). Used as a na-adjective to describe people, lifestyles, and creative works that are unconstrained by convention. The tone is generally admiring, but in some contexts it can suggest someone is irresponsible or undisciplined.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {自由奔放|じゆうほんぽう}な⟦{性格|せいかく}→性格：03371_seikaku⟧: free-spirited personality
- {自由奔放|じゆうほんぽう}な⟦{生活|せいかつ}→生活：01443_seikatsu⟧: uninhibited lifestyle
- {自由奔放|じゆうほんぽう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{生|い}きる→生きる：01184_ikiru⟧: to live freely
- {自由奔放|じゆうほんぽう}な⟦{作風|さくふう}→作風：11460_sakufuu⟧: freewheeling creative style

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{奔放|ほんぽう}→奔放：20059_honpou⟧: unrestrained — the second half alone; slightly more literary
- {自由気|じゆうき}まま: doing as one pleases — more casual and everyday
- ⟦{天真爛漫|てんしんらんまん}→天真爛漫：22150_tenshinranman⟧: innocent and carefree — emphasizes childlike openness rather than defiance of convention
